verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Workers as a general serverless/edge compute platform (deployment, bindings, frameworks, Wrangler CLI) but never mentions the underlying isolate/sandbox security model, hardware isolation guarantees, or a use case of running untrusted third-party code (e.g. Workers for Platforms, V8 isolate security boundaries). No citation addresses sandboxing untrusted code specifically. Missing for 10: any mention of V8 isolate/hardware isolation architecture, security boundary guarantees for untrusted code, or a multi-tenant 'Workers for Platforms' style product, and any independent security audit/hands-on evidence of sandbox isolation.
